topic: Factors Influencing Fairness in Computer Science Paper Acceptance and Review Processes
topic_description: The topic explores the fairness in the acceptance of papers in computer science, focusing on the influence of conference/workshop/journal quality, reviewer expertise, author reputation, institutional affiliation, and geographic location on decision-making. It also examines the outcomes when expert reviewers lack strong opinions and investigates the persistence of non-double-blind review processes in paper submissions.
